title: Integral specialization of the adic stratified-perfect criterion
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and selected uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, put $A=\operatorname{ULift}(R)$ and $I=(\operatorname{ULift}(\pi))\subseteq A$, and let $B=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/I^n)_X$ be the actual completed coefficient ring sheaf on the pro-étale site of $X$ [det-prop-integral-criterion-constant-coefficients]. For every $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B))$, stratified perfect coefficient models and adic constructibility [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data] are equivalent. Moreover $A$ is Noetherian and $I$-adically complete, and $I$ is its unique maximal ideal.

proof.text: Read the DVR, its maximal ideal and chosen generator from the selected coefficient datum. Apply finite_module_adic_complete_and_hom to the integer ring as a finite module over itself, with all universe parameters fixed. Transport Noetherianity and completeness to ULift along its ring equivalence; map_span identifies the chosen ideal, and ideal transport preserves maximality and uniqueness. This proves integral_coefficient_hypotheses.
Instantiate adic_stratified_perfect with the lifted coefficient ring and its ideal, using those coefficient hypotheses, and reverse its first equivalence.

theorem integral_stratified_perfect_iff_adic_constructible
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X
      (adicLisseCompletedRing X
        (ProEtale.IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E)))) :
    IsSfbStratifiedPerfect X
        (ProEtale.IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E) K ↔
      IsSfbAdicConstructible X
        (ProEtale.IntegralConstantCompletion.ideal l E) K
